record.source: Measurement tables read from each plate's database and merged into one analysis frame. Only 'cell', 'nucleus', 'pathogen', 'cytoplasm', and 'png_list' are merged. Any other table, including 'organelle', is loaded but omitted from the merged result without a warning. Default ['cell', 'nucleus', 'pathogen', 'cytoplasm'].
record.translation: Mättabeller som läses från varje plattas databas och slås ihop till en analysram. Bara 'cell', 'nucleus', 'pathogen', 'cytoplasm' och 'png_list' slås ihop. Alla andra tabeller, även 'organelle', läses in men utelämnas ur det sammanslagna resultatet utan varning. Standard ['cell', 'nucleus', 'pathogen', 'cytoplasm'].
